title: Amount presentation can misstate money: "Total P&L" adds only the realized P&L of still-open positions (unrealized and closed trades are left out), the high-water mark (a probe quote) is printed as an ETH amount, every amount is cut to 4 decimals with no unit, and the sell confirmations show no amount at all

evidence.note: Total P&L = sum of p.pnl over the open positions
p.pnl is trades.realized_pnl (partial-sell proceeds only for an open position); unrealizedPnl is a separate field the stat ignores
High-Water Mark rendered with formatEth from exitState.highWaterMark
highWaterMark is the raw exit_state.high_water_mark (the engine's probe quote, AUD-EXIT-003), not an ETH amount
formatPnL / formatEth: toFixed(4), no unit; anything below 0.00005 prints 0.0000 and a tiny loss prints "-0.0000"
"-0.0000" is coloured as a loss, "+0.0000" as a profit
Total Exposure printed with toFixed(4) and no unit
Buy Cost and Gas Cost at 4 decimals (L2 gas usually reads 0.0000)
the donut centre adds the per-chain native amounts into one number
Force Sell dialog names the token by address prefix and chain; no amount, value or estimated proceeds
Emergency Sell All dialog shows no position count or value

sibling_sites_checked: Every formatter call in the dashboard (formatEth in PositionTable, TradeTable, ExposureDonut; formatPnL in Overview, PositionTable, TradeTable; raw toFixed in Overview.tsx:70, :199, PositionTable.tsx:222, :242, RiskExposure.tsx:57, AntiRugExitDetailModal.tsx:185, :191). The values themselves: Current price and unrealized P&L fallbacks are AUD-API-016; the daily-loss gauge dividing an amount by a percentage is AUD-API-017; mixed-unit sums behind exposure, realized P&L and sell revenue are AUD-DB-002; failed-held positions left out of counts and exposure are AUD-API-001 (all linked, not repeated). The cross-chain sum (ETH plus BNB) is latent while only ETH is enabled. Layout numbers (sizes, colours, chart heights) are cosmetic and excluded, stated once here.
severity_rationale: S3: operationally relevant presentation (never cosmetic): the headline Total P&L can read +0.0000 while every open position is losing, the high-water mark is a different unit printed as ETH, and small amounts vanish to 0.0000; the operator reads these next to the sell buttons. Not S2: the bot's own decisions do not use these numbers, and the larger unit defects underneath are registered separately at their own severity.
recommendation: Compute Total P&L from unrealized plus realized (and say which); label every amount with its unit and chain; show small amounts with significant digits instead of a fixed 4 decimals; do not print the engine high-water mark as ETH; show the position size and last known value in the Force Sell and Emergency Sell dialogs. Phase 29 (with the unit fixes of AUD-DB-002 / AUD-API-016 in Phase 24).
